segments.text: Yea and to ſay the trueth, it might not be eſchued, but that euen the very nature of GOD, if it were bodily, ſhould admit both diuiſion and limitation. Since therefore that theſe things be on this wiſe, euen as the fathers doe moſt fully teſtifie, it is altogether proued, that the body of Chriſt is ſubiect to theſe properties and qualities.
